stem.en: Which one is not a measure of software science theory?

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: Checked against the printed publisher key.

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 6.11; publisher key p. 499

explanation.ar: logic ليس من مقاييس Software Science المعتمدة.
explanation.en: Halstead's Software Science suite includes Vocabulary ($\eta$), Length ($N$), Volume ($V$), Potential Volume ($V^*$), Program Level ($L$), Difficulty ($D$), Effort ($E$), Time ($T$), and Language Level ($\lambda$). There is no measure named "Logic" in Halstead's theory.

explanation.en: No unique key can be verified from the supplied course item. The stem says “international standard for size measure,” while the options are LOC, Function count, Program length, and None of the above. The source does not define what “international standard” means here or provide an answer key. Choice (b) may be the intended classroom answer if “Function count” is being used loosely for function-oriented sizing, but that interpretation is not established by the item itself.

explanation.en: Response For a Class (RFC) and Coupling Between Objects (CBO) belong to the seminal Chidamber & Kemerer (CK) suite, and Data Access Component (DAC) belongs to the Li & Henry object-oriented metrics suite.

explanation.ar: DIT يقيس أقصى مسار من الصنف إلى جذره عبر الأصناف السلف.
explanation.en: In companion slide 100 and textbook scan p. 305, Depth of Inheritance Tree (DIT) is defined as the number of ancestor classes (the maximum path length from the class node to the root class of the inheritance tree). Successor classes correspond to descendants/subclasses (measured by NOC - Number of Children).

stem.ar: أي مما يلي ليس مقياس حجم؟
stem.en: Which one is not a size measure ?

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: Checked against the printed publisher key.

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 6.20; publisher key p. 499

explanation.ar: cyclomatic complexity مقياس تعقيد وليس حجم.
explanation.en: Cyclomatic Complexity is a control-flow structural complexity metric measuring linearly independent basis paths, not an attribute of software size. In contrast, LOC, FP, and Halstead's Program Length are recognized physical or functional size metrics.
